name: Jetmir
description: Jetmir is the horned leonin boss and founder of the Cabaretti crime family in New Capenna, a cat demon and the adoptive father of Jinnie Fay.

timeline.summary: Jinnie and Jetmir plan the Crescendo and discuss the Adversary and the Font.
timeline.quote: "Besides, the moment the Font is revealed, everything in New Capenna will change and the Cabaretti will be on top."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Jinnie abandons Giada on stage to rush to Jetmir, who is cornered and outnumbered.
timeline.quote: Jinnie leapt into the fray, weapons drawn, leaving Giada behind.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Jinnie, Jetmir and Cabaretti emerge and demand Giada be brought to them; Elspeth, sensing Giada's wishes, refuses.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Officers report Jetmir gravely wounded, the Cabaretti neutralized and other families compromised; Ob Nixilis orders the families' heads and a hunt for the Font.
timeline.quote: "I want the families' heads. All of them.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Kitt sings to the pigeons in a subway station when Jetmir stops to listen.
timeline.quote: this bigwig had halted right in front of her.

citation.text: "Alley Cat Blues" by Rhiannon Rasmussen. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Jetmir offers Kitt the warm-up slot at the Red Room tonight if she delivers a bag of Halo to a Cabaretti agent in Park Heights.
timeline.quote: "The warm-up slot at the Red Room tonight is yours, little songstress.

citation.text: "Alley Cat Blues" by Rhiannon Rasmussen. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Jetmir praises Kitt on stage and promises her a higher billing tomorrow night, having tested her.
timeline.quote: "We'll see Miss Kitt Kanto again tomorrow night, with a higher billing and a few more songs."

citation.text: "Alley Cat Blues" by Rhiannon Rasmussen. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Giada defends Elspeth, persuading Jinnie to let Jetmir decide; Jinnie shackles the two and takes them with Giada to see Jetmir.
timeline.quote: "Shackle them. We're taking them back to Jetmir."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Jinnie leads them to an Obscura hideout where Kamiz welcomes them, and a wounded Jetmir is being treated.
timeline.quote: "I see you were successful." Jetmir was settled in a lower bunk

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis strikes the families' leadership on the night of the Crescendo, killing Xander and mortally wounding Jetmir; Giada's sacrifice awakens the angels.
timeline.quote: At least one boss, Xander , was killed, with Jetmir mortally wounded.

citation.text: "Capenna", section "The Adversary War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis infiltrates the plane and strikes the families' leadership on the night of the Crescendo; Xander is killed and Jetmir wounded.
timeline.quote: At least one boss, Xander , was killed, with Jetmir seriously wounded.

citation.text: "New Capenna", section "The Adversary War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The archdemons betray the angels, turning their bodies into Halo, defeat the Phyrexians, and raise five individuals to demonic status over five factions.
timeline.quote: the archdemons proved their nature and captured the angels

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Capenna", section "Betrayal and the creation of Halo". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Cabaretti are unmentioned during Atraxa's slaughter, though Jetmir remains active.
timeline.quote: The Cabaretti were conspicuously unmentioned by the defenders of Capenna during Atraxa's slaughter.

citation.text: "Cabaretti", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Discovered by Cabaretti scouts, Giada is found able to turn sewage into pure Halo and the Cabaretti keep her secret.
timeline.quote: she could turn even the foulest city sewage into pure Halo

citation.text: "Giada", section "New Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Crescendo celebration, Jetmir is gravely wounded by agents of the Adversary and tended to by his adopted daughter in an Obscura safehouse.
timeline.quote: Jetmir was gravely wounded by agents of the Adversary

citation.text: "Jetmir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: By the New Phyrexian Invasion, Jetmir has recovered and complains about use of his Halo reserves against the invaders.
timeline.quote: he seemed to have recovered, complaining about the use of his Halo reserves against the invaders

citation.text: "Jetmir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
